title: Pencil keyline botanical

reference.grammar: colored pencil on flat cream, red-orange keyline inside teal/blue/olive plates, no line on the bloom

units: design units, 1000 = plate width (ref 1200 px ⇒ 1 u = 1.2 ref px)

techniques.name: Directional pencil grain

params.light: mix(fill,#fff,0.20); coral uses #FB6A2C to keep chroma
params.teal_scumble: 1 per 9000 u², 1.2–2.4 u, α0.35 pale teal
params.tooth: hash noise on a 1.6 u cell, ±7 % L on red pigment, ±2 % elsewhere, none on paper

techniques.implementation: Short 1 u strokes along each plate’s axis field (radial for fans and throat, petal-axis for lobes) in lighter and darker fill tints at α 0.32, clipped to the plate; then an ImageData pass multiplies every non-transparent pixel by 1±amp·hash(⌊x/1.6u⌋,⌊y/1.6u⌋), amp 0.07 where R>G+40 else 0.02.

techniques.name: Contrast keyline
techniques.implementation: Silhouette polylines are offset 1 u inward along their normals, displaced by a 3-octave 1-D sine noise of the arc length (amp 1.2 u), and stroked in 8-point segments whose width varies ±18 %; a second 3.2 u pass at α 0.55 with a faster waver frays the edges.

techniques.name: Radial striation

params.curve: quadratic, control bowed 0.10·r off the radial

techniques.implementation: One quadratic per ray from the fan root to the rim at angular pitch = 30 u / rim radius, clipped to the fan, then a 6.75 u teal band stroked on the silhouette before the keyline leaves a 4 u gap.

techniques.name: Dry-brush bristle fringe

params.blob_centre: root + 38 u along the leaf axis (the blob is the leaf’s basal lobe)
params.mask: own layer, destination-in with leaf ∪ blob(+3 u) ∪ stems (never onto paper; no clip-seam darkening)

techniques.implementation: A solid blue ellipse (58×46 u) at the leaf root, then a 900-stroke opaque band straddling the rim so the disc edge never shows, a solid #1E3CC0 core 38 u across set 12 u up the axis, then 5200 radial strokes (on a layer masked by leaf, blob and stems) starting anywhere inside the blob, each drawn as 5–11 dashes with random gaps and per-dash alpha, color running from a deep #17327C at the root to #1D4888 within the first 28 % of the reach, alpha falling (1−t)^1.8 to zero 40–180 u past the edge; the blob and its rim get 360 lighter streaks.

techniques.name: Radial pencil ramp
techniques.implementation: 14000 short radial strokes at α 0.42 from the throat point, each colored by the ramp at (r ± 6 % jitter) and lightened or darkened ±14 % so the ramp is pencil-grained so the stops are ragged, over a flat coral fill; grain strokes on top.

techniques.name: Cream stamen with ring
techniques.implementation: Cubic from the throat splaying outward, stroked cream; the end gets a cream disc then an olive ring.

techniques.name: Olive petal vein
techniques.implementation: Four cubics per back petal run parallel to the petal axis from base to tip without converging; each front lobe gets four transverse quadratic ribs, olive doubled by a tan line 2.8 u below.

techniques.name: Bristle stem gradient
techniques.implementation: Teal ribbon segment under the center bloom, then 700 vertical blue strokes whose alpha rises with depth, clipped to the ribbon.

techniques.name: Ribbon stem
techniques.implementation: Cubic centerlines are offset ±15 u along their normals into closed ribbons, split at a parameter into black and blue fills, and keylined as one silhouette.

techniques.name: Olive mound
techniques.implementation: Cosine dome polygon filled flat with faint grain; the keyline is stroked from base corner to base corner over the arc and skips the base.

pass_order: plates (fans, stems, mound, bloom cups, buds)
notes: All numbers measured on ref-01.png at 900 px and scaled ×1.11 to 1000 design units.
Reference area shares: cream 0.30, teal 0.30, red 0.17, blue 0.07, black 0.02, orange 0.03, yellow 0.014.
